## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-3-95d007dd`

Fix gas-exchange scaling so total O2/CO2 surface flux depends on exposed area instead of water volume. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/dissolved_oxygen.rs:14-28` computes `K_LA` from lid/aeration/filter settings only, and `crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs:55-58` / `crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs:571-580` reuse that coefficient in `delta = k_la * (c_eq - c) * volume_l`. With that math, two tanks that share the same footprint and hardware but have different fill heights exchange different total CO2 masses; the deeper tank strips proportionally more CO2 even though the air-water interface is unchanged. The new regression at `crates/tank_core/tests/co2_exchange.rs:215-285` locks in that incorrect behavior by asserting equal concentration change instead of equal surface flux. Use a surface-area/volume term when deriving gas-transfer rates (for both O2 and CO2); `crates/tank_core/src/types/geometry.rs:64-72` already exposes a ratio helper you can build from.
